_README: Copy this file to site-secrets.json and set a real password.
site-secrets.json is gitignored and must NEVER be committed.
The password is injected into each note's frontmatter at export time, so it
never exists in the vault or in the public repo. Change it here, re-run
update-site.py, and every protected page is re-encrypted with the new one.
Pick a long passphrase, not a word. The encrypted pages are public files:
anyone can download them once and attack them offline, forever. Four or five
unrelated words is fine; 'arch2026' is not.
Share it with the team somewhere that is not the repo.
